title: Muse Spark Open
author: bigwheels
relevanceReason: 命中 1 个 AI/科技关键词。

comments.author: a11r
comments.textRawHtml:
Artificial analysis shows this: underperforming Qwen3.8 Flash Next and GLM 5.3 Flash, both of which you can run on a single B300 . I think Meta has a bit of catching up to do in the open-weight space.

As an aside, it's really unfortunate that artificial analysis only provides comparison at the highest reasoning level, which is mostly unusable for high-volume production use cases. I would really like them to start providing comparisons at low and medium reasoning levels across these models because those tend to be the ones that actually get used in production.
comments.textZhHtml:
人工分析表明：Qwen3.8 Flash Next 和 GLM 5.3 Flash 的性能较差，这两者都可以在单个 B300 上运行。我认为 Meta 在开放权重领域还需要迎头赶上。

顺便说一句，人工分析只能提供最高推理级别的比较，这对于大批量生产用例来说几乎无法使用，这确实很不幸。我真的希望他们开始在这些模型中提供中低推理水平的比较，因为这些模型往往是实际在生产中使用的模型。

children.author: alexpotato
children.textRawHtml:
Been using GLM 5.3 Flash via Ollama Cloud basic subscription:

if this is the only model I had to use for the rest of my life, I would be cool with that. It's good at a wide variety of tasks including reverse engineering, design, working with ESP 32 etc.

I think Muse Spark 1.3 is better but GLM 5.3 Flash is an excellent daily driver.
children.textZhHtml:
一直通过 Ollama Cloud 基本订阅使用 GLM 5.3 Flash：

如果这是我余生必须使用的唯一模型，我会很乐意接受。它擅长执行各种任务，包括逆向工程、设计、使用 ESP 32 等。

我认为 Muse Spark 1.3 更好，但 GLM 5.3 Flash 是一款出色的日常驱动程序。

children.author: colingauvin
children.textRawHtml: It is unreal how good GLM 5.3 Flash is. There's an ~4 bpw EXL3 quant that fits on 2x DGX Sparks. I'm not sure it's worth it now ($7k/Spark) or even when I bought them ($4k/Spark) but there's something about knowing that the whole internet could go down and I could still have this model running at 50-60 tokens/s with 1M context, indefinitely. It's just so good. TensorFold hits 100+ tokens/s in aggregate with 2-3 M total context pool. It's like having Claude at home.
children.textZhHtml: GLM 5.3 Flash 有多好是难以置信的。有一个 ~4 bpw EXL3 Quant，适合 2x DGX Sparks。我不确定它现在是否值得（7000 美元/Spark），甚至当我购买它们时（4000 美元/Spark），但我知道整个互联网可能会崩溃，但我仍然可以让这个模型以 50-60 个代币/秒的速度和 1M 上下文无限期地运行。真是太好了。 TensorFold 总计达到 100+ tokens/s，上下文池总数为 2-3 M。这就像克劳德在家一样。

children.author: bigyabai
children.textRawHtml:
I'm using Flash and the full 5.3 model side-by-side, and for coding I'm hard-pressed to find a difference. Flash is slightly worse at steering in longer contexts, but writes code that's just as good as anything I get out of full 5.3. You could totally build a SaaS or video game with nothing but 5.3 Flash.

The full 5.3 is only really needed for super deep bugfixes/profiling passes, or ridiculous reverse-engineering in my experience.
children.textZhHtml:
我并排使用 Flash 和完整的 5.3 模型，在编码方面我很难找到差异。 Flash 在较长的上下文中控制稍差，但编写的代码与我从完整的 5.3 中得到的代码一样好。您完全可以只使用 5.3 Flash 来构建 SaaS 或视频游戏。

完整的 5.3 仅真正需要用于超深的错误修复/分析过程，或者根据我的经验进行荒谬的逆向工程。

children.author: colingauvin
children.textRawHtml: Yeah, MiMo Pro is the first Chinese model I can really clearly identify as an upgrade over GLM 5.3 Flash. K3, Qwen 3.8 Pro, GLM 5.3, DS4.1 Flash all feel around equivalent to me. Oddly lots of people have derided MiMo but I have found it able to tackle slightly tougher problems. For instance, I tried GLM 5.3 Flash, DS4.1 Flash, and MiMo Pro on making a new map layer for my Garmin watch, and MiMo was the only one that found the actual best method (.img file for OSM).
children.textZhHtml: 是的，MiMo Pro 是第一款我可以真正清楚地识别为 GLM 5.3 Flash 升级版的中国型号。 K3、Qwen 3.8 Pro、GLM 5.3、DS4.1 Flash都感觉和我差不多。奇怪的是，很多人嘲笑 MiMo，但我发现它能够解决稍微棘手的问题。例如，我尝试过 GLM 5.3 Flash、DS4.1 Flash 和 MiMo Pro 为我的 Garmin 手表制作新的地图图层，而 MiMo 是唯一找到实际最佳方法（OSM 的 .img 文件）的人。

children.author: satirr
children.textRawHtml:
Garmin.img thing is the interesting, but not really on my Experience.

Been running the same stuff on GLM 5.3 Flash, Deepseek v4p, Qwen 3.x model and Mimo v2.x pro model. Mimo faster yeah, but its hallucinate more and losses the thread easier. And when the context window is not limited, when usage of >200k token, is loss context. even he didnt know what im sayin.

Also, sometimes he Had a Loop over and over, for the same tool call (on my case is Grep and Read. >15x looping) until is burning a bunch of context for nothing. GLM and Deepseek doesn't do that (but the deepseek Hallucinations is huge asf too).

children.author: lifeisloving
children.textRawHtml: In my experience, like most models, it requires a ton of supervision. It is extermely verbose. Flash loves to create some wildly unecessary abstractions/spaghetti code (like most llms). It wants to implement things in the least effecient manner and needs to be reminded constantly not to do things a certain way.
children.textZhHtml: 根据我的经验，与大多数模型一样，它需要大量的监督。这是极其冗长的。 Flash 喜欢创建一些极其不必要的抽象/意大利面条式代码（就像大多数 llms 一样）。它希望以最低效率的方式执行事情，并且需要不断提醒不要以某种方式做事。

children.author: meeq
children.textRawHtml:
Am I the only one experiencing accidental chinese tokens, wrong grammar, and other sloppy mistakes in almost every output when using GLM 5.3? I feel like using it through any kind of subscription service (z.ai, Opencode Go) just serves me aggressive quants.

On some days it's usable, but on most days it feels more like having to trust a pretty smart intern that may or may not get a small stroke every couple of minutes.
children.textZhHtml:
我是唯一一个在使用 GLM 5.3 时在几乎每个输出中都遇到意外中文标记、错误语法和其他草率错误的人吗？我觉得通过任何类型的订阅服务（z.ai、Opencode Go）使用它都只会为我激进的量化分析师服务。

在某些日子里它是可用的，但在大多数日子里，感觉更像是必须信任一个非常聪明的实习生，他可能会或可能不会每隔几分钟就得到一次小中风。

children.author: 59nadir
children.textRawHtml: I've only ever gotten sudden chinese (and some other script I couldn't identify) from GPT5.6 Luna via OpenAI. It's a very interesting failure mode.
children.textZhHtml: 我只通过 OpenAI 从 GPT5.6 Luna 突然获得了中文（以及一些我无法识别的其他脚本）。这是一种非常有趣的故障模式。

children.author: jubilee33
children.textRawHtml:
Never had that happen at all and using since launch as well, but I have a very custom harness running. My local machine went down however and I used their web API to repair it and talking to that felt much stupider, I think harness really matters Alot.

I do get the really annoying LLM "that's A, not B" and "load-bearing" from time to time, those two tells stay no matter what I do even though the rest of the output is pretty amazing,
children.textZhHtml:

我确实时不时得到非常烦人的 LLM“那是 A，而不是 B”和“承重”，无论我做什么，这两个告诉都会留下来，即使其余的输出非常惊人，

children.author: Scaled
children.textRawHtml: How do you feel it compares to DeepSeek 0731 if you have tried that?  (Also runs well on 2x spark)
children.textZhHtml: 如果您尝试过，与 DeepSeek 0731 相比您感觉如何？  （在 2x Spark 上也运行良好）

children.author: colingauvin
children.textRawHtml: I was running DS731 until Qwen 3.8 Flash Next (so what, like a couple weeks? The pace has been torrid). I switched to Qwen for image input, then GLM 5.3 Flash. At the time, Qwen felt like a minor step down from DS731, GLM 5.3 Flash feels like a major step up from Qwen, so I'd say slightly better than DS731. I realize that's not exactly what the benchmarks say, but DS731 definitely flailed around on some of the more challenging things that GLM mostly gets for me.
children.textZhHtml: 我一直在运行 DS731，直到 Qwen 3.8 Flash Next（那又怎样，比如几周？速度太快了）。我改用 Qwen 进行图像输入，然后改用 GLM 5.3 Flash。当时，Qwen 感觉比 DS731 稍微下降了一点，GLM 5.3 Flash 感觉比 Qwen 进步了一大步，所以我想说比 DS731 稍好一些。我意识到这并不完全是基准测试所说的那样，但 DS731 确实在 GLM 为我提供的一些更具挑战性的事情上表现不佳。

children.author: Scaled

children.author: orbifold
children.textRawHtml: How did you setup the 2x dgx spark?
children.textZhHtml: 您是如何设置 2x dgx Spark 的？

children.author: colingauvin
children.textRawHtml:
Pretty much just this, but tweaked to have I think 64 active conversations be cacheable, which drops the context pool to ~2M.

https://github.com/MiaAI-Lab/GLM-5.3-Flash-EXL3-2x-DGX-Spark...

I also had to downclock my Sparks (Asus) slightly, to 2000 Mhz. Otherwise they'd overheat and crash.
children.textZhHtml:
差不多就是这样，但经过调整，我认为 64 个活动对话可以缓存，这会将上下文池降低到约 2M。

https://github.com/MiaAI-Lab/GLM-5.3-Flash-EXL3-2x-DGX-Spark...

我还必须将我的 Sparks（华硕）的时钟稍微降低到 2000 Mhz。否则它们会过热并崩溃。
